deltas.candidate_phrase: hands-on experience with a cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP)
data-pipeline experience (Spark, Airflow, dbt or similar)
working knowledge of SQL and a query engine
experience presenting results visually (Tableau, Power BI or Matplotlib)

sentences.sentence: Your CV says you haven't worked hands-on with a cloud platform, so building practical experience with AWS, Azure or GCP takes around three months.
If you have worked with data pipelines such as Spark, Airflow or dbt, say so on your CV; building that experience typically takes about two months.
If you have working knowledge of SQL and a query engine, name it on your CV; picking it up usually takes about a month.
If you have presented results visually using Tableau, Power BI or Matplotlib, mention it; gaining that experience typically takes around one month.
If you have applied statistics like hypothesis testing, regression or uncertainty, add it to your CV; learning it usually takes about three months.
